actual_product_shape: An evidence-rich deterministic authorization/replay/reservation kernel and corpus runner; not yet a production enforcement service.
heart_of_mission: Make an authorization decision reproducible at the execution boundary, bind it to a specific operation contract and identity context, durably reserve the resulting effect, and prevent the same one-time authority from becoming effective twice across retry, restart, and local restore.
missing_boundaries: one narrow deployable authorization-and-reservation API whose request cannot select trust roots, policy, clock, proof secret, backend, or restore behavior
transactional outbox/equivalent reserve-before-effect protocol with reconciliation from authoritative downstream state
operator-owned authenticated configuration and separated key domains
sender proof-of-possession such as DPoP or certificate-bound access tokens
authenticated operation-contract release/root rather than labels from the same controls bundle
exact integer parsing, URI-reference validation, hard input/resource limits, and trusted runtime time
external witness/checkpoints and authenticated build provenance
recommended_order: production adapter plus operator configuration boundary
sender possession, trusted clock, exact parsing, limits, and contract authenticity
migrate every remaining custom signing/hash input with explicit old-ledger handling
external witness, provenance, real fuzzing, and only then additional restore depth tied to recovery objectives

severe_failures_found_across_lineage.failure: SQLite persisted an empty contract digest in 326 accepted rows while the hash chain and all then-current tests passed.
severe_failures_found_across_lineage.lesson: Internal consistency and counters do not prove semantic binding; durable fields must round-trip from verified inputs.

severe_failures_found_across_lineage.failure: Raw newline-delimited proof/effect/event identity composition was non-injective; one HMAC authenticated two distinct crafted event identities.
severe_failures_found_across_lineage.lesson: Security material needs unambiguous framing plus adversarial cross-field substitution tests.

severe_failures_found_across_lineage.failure: The active capability declared parent rev0629 while the package manifest declared parent rev0630, and its purpose overstated cloned-ledger protection.
severe_failures_found_across_lineage.lesson: Claims and lineage are security metadata and need one generated source of truth.

speculation: The likely useful product is a small authorization-and-idempotency sidecar/service for gateways and brokers, not a monolithic gateway.
AnonSync is probably a historical name: the retained cube implements neither anonymity nor multi-node synchronization.
The cube can be valuable as an evolutionary proof laboratory if production code, evidence code, and active claims are sharply separated.
waste_or_misallocation: restore and signed-transition sophistication advanced ahead of the ingress and execution boundary
reporting_selftests.cpp and sqlite_replay_ledger.cpp contain about 72% of production source lines
historically named fuzz executables are deterministic selftest launchers, not coverage-guided fuzzers
large generated fixtures and binary bytes dominate review payload
boolean-heavy self-authored capabilities can look like assurance without independent authentication
revision cadence rewarded locally provable metadata and recovery features while external integration remained deferred
